content: Aden Esus chuiquin abia tantiamiaid bëdamboen tantiashun abipadquid icnuequin abi chuiquin tantiamiaid utsi tantiaquionona. Abia tantiamiaid nad iqueque. Tantia. Chuinu. Esus tantiaquid icta. Adquid icquin icsaid ënta. Adembidi, Nuquin Papan chiaid tantiaquidquio icta.

Adembidi, Esus tantiaquin acten mentometa. Adembidi, Nuquin Papan abi tantiaquid aton Mayan menenuequin mëdanten mamishaid icta. Adembidi, Abi tantiaquid unësash uincuente iquec, quequin tantiaquidquio icta. Adembidi, Abi tantiesa cuidtequid iquendac, quequin tantiec bëdamboec tabadteneta.
Aidtedi mimbi tantioc. Aidtedi tantiaquioshon, Adembidi ambi tantiamiaid utsitedi tantianuna, quequin tantiaquin nabanta.
Aden Esuquidistu tantiasho isun aton Mayan Nuquin Papan meniaid icboedi
Nuquin Papan chiacpadomboen nadatiambocquin nabamboed,

Esus matsesquio yec icsamboquid nepanëdash, quiash, Esus cuesten dectan, quequidbimboecquid icsho Nuquin Papan aid isendac. Aidën oncain Esus mamënshunec. Aden Esus tantienquio yanacsho bëdamboen tantiamenuen chuiquin, Icsaobique. Ëbi icsaid ënu, cametiapimbo Nuquin Papan iquendac.
Baded-badedquiec ue sequequin nidaid pachi uaidën tiedën caniquid caniacsho taneshcaquidën petequid nendac. Adecbidi Esuquidistu chuibanac abi tantiaquiosho Icbon yuedaido iquendac.
Echobëd cana shëta chedo ëshë idash dadpen yanushe queshun nëdëncatequid nendac. Adecbidi icsamboen chiaid tantiaquid uquë nësiatequid nendac.

Aden mibi chuiquimbi, Nuquin Papan nësiatemaid mibi nec, quequin tantiembi. Esuquidistu tantiaquid yec abi tantiaquid utsibobëd tantiananec bëdamboec tabadquin ismequid nec, quequin mibi chuiquin utsibon chioshi.
Adoac abi tantiaquid utsibo tantiaquin mimbi nashundeniaid Nuquin Papan bëpiscudenquiocquin tantiec.
Adecbidi utsibobëd tantiananec mibi bëdamboec tabadpashun. Adec tabadash abi yacno puduedsho, Bëdamboen mimbi nabanoc, Nuquin Papan mibi caindac.

Aden nabanec chieshenquiocquin Nuquin Papan chiaid tantiaquioquin tsusedpabomba caimbudec unësash Nuquin Papa yacno puduedampicpadec Esuquidistu tantiaquioquin ënenquiocquin caimbudequi ma Nuquin Papa yacno puduedpanuna.
Naden nanu quec Nuquin Papa muatiapimbo iquec
Ëndenquimboshë Abadauan bëdamboec tabadsho isun ambia tantiaquidquio abi yampidquiobidi icquin, Ëmbibi tantiacpadomboen nanuna. Abimbo caimbi, quequin Nuquin Papan naden chuipampic:
“Mimbi tishmiaidën tsyuecquido dadpen iquendac, queshun ëmbi chiacpadomboen nabanquin mibi, Bëdambo iquebi, camembi,” quequin Nuquin Papan Abadauan chuipampic.
Aden chuisho tantiashun caimbudquin tishtiapimbocquidëmbi Abadauanën chidon aton mado tishpampic.
Abimbo caimbi, quequin abitedi tantiaquidënquio Nuquin Papan chiac utsi, Muenec, quetiapimbo iquendac.
Adembidi, Ëbi yacno tabadte iquendac, quequin ënden yampidën Nuquin Papan chiaid chuca uatiapimbo iquebi, quequin Esuquidistu tantiaquido tantiamenuen abimbo caimbi, quequin chuipanëdash.

Adec Nuquin Papa muatiapimbo icquin ambi chiacpadomboen naquidquio Nuquin Papa nec. Adembidi, Ëbi yacno tabadte iquec, quequin chiaid chuca uatiapimbo iquec. Adquid Nuquin Papa icnuc abi yacno ëbi puduedmequid Esus iquec, quequin caimbudquid nuqui nendac.
Aden caimbudquin, Ënden Nuquin Papa yacno puduedshun ëbi yuedquid iquec, quequin nuqui tantiec.
Nuqui caintequid Esuquidistu ënden Nuquin Papa yacno bëyucanec abi tantiaquido chuibanec Nuquin Papabëd onquenuec puduedash Medquisedecpadquid yampanëdash.
